candidates.test_case: Measure chromaticity of each function on both left and right lamps.
candidates.applies_because: Each function of the paired rear lamps is a lamp constituting a pair.

candidates.text: The left and right rear lamps of a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics.
candidates.test_case: Compare photometric measurements of each function on the left and right lamps.
candidates.applies_because: Each function of the paired rear lamps is a lamp constituting a pair.

candidates.text: In case the rear lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo may be fitted on the rear of the vehicle.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the vehicle rear for the number and arrangement of logos in lamps.
candidates.applies_because: The manufacturer logo in the lamp is an open option.

candidates.text: In case the rear lamp incorporates a logo, the logo shall be a vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logo; all other logos are prohibited.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the logo content of the lamp.
candidates.applies_because: The manufacturer logo in the lamp is an open option.

candidates.text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the pair requirements for the rear lamps shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
candidates.test_case: Assess the pair symmetry of the lamps against the vehicle shape.
candidates.applies_because: This applies if the M1 vehicle rear is asymmetrical.

candidates.text: The rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements are fulfilled.
candidates.test_case: Verify each function's colour, position, orientation, visibility and wiring on the installed combination lamp.
candidates.applies_because: The product integrates several functions in one lamp body.

candidates.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of each function of the rear lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which it is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
candidates.test_case: Measure photometry and colour of each function with the other functions switched OFF.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp groups or incorporates rear position, stop and reversing functions.

candidates.text: In case the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp, the colour requirements of the stop lamp shall be fulfilled when the stop lamp and the rear position lamp are switched ON together.
candidates.test_case: Measure stop lamp chromaticity with the rear position lamp also ON.
candidates.applies_because: Reciprocal incorporation of the rear position and stop lamps is an open option.

candidates.text: In case a rear lamp function is a single lamp whose apparent surface is composed of two or more distinct parts, either the total projected area of the distinct parts in the direction of the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest circumscribing quadrilateral, or the distance between facing edges of adjacent distinct parts shall not exceed 75 mm, measured perpendicularly to the reference axis; this does not apply to a single retro-reflector.
candidates.test_case: Measure the projected apparent surface areas, or the gaps between segments, in the direction of the reference axis.
candidates.applies_because: The LED reflector-cup design may create a segmented apparent surface.

candidates.text: In case a function is provided by an assembly of two lamps marked "D", either the projected apparent surfaces of the two lamps shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest circumscribing quadrilateral, or the distance between their facing edges shall not exceed 75 mm, measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
candidates.test_case: Measure the apparent surfaces of the two 'D' lamps as installed.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp may be part of a lamp marked 'D' assembly (open option).

candidates.text: In case a function is provided by an interdependent lamp system marked "Y", the system shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1 (60 per cent of the circumscribing quadrilateral or a gap of at most 75 mm).
candidates.test_case: Measure the projected apparent surfaces of the interdependent lamps.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp may be part of an interdependent lamp system marked 'Y' (open option).

candidates.text: Two or more lamps or separate apparent surfaces included in the same lamp body or behind a common outer lens shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system, unless the lamp is in the shape of a band or strip.
candidates.test_case: Review the lamp classification against the lamp body and lens construction.
candidates.applies_because: The combination lamp has several functions in one body behind a common lens.

candidates.text: The maximum height above the ground of each rear lamp function shall be measured from the highest point, and the minimum height from the lowest point, of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
candidates.test_case: Measure the highest and lowest points of each function's apparent surface above the ground.
candidates.applies_because: This defines how the height limits of the lamp functions are assessed.

candidates.text: For the purpose of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the height of the rear lamp above the ground shall be measured from the H plane.
candidates.test_case: Measure the H-plane height of the installed lamp.
candidates.applies_because: Reduced vertical visibility angles may apply to low-mounted rear functions.

candidates.text: The width position of each rear lamp function shall be determined from the edge of the apparent surface furthest from the median longitudinal plane for the overall-width distance, and from the inner edges of the apparent surfaces for the distance between lamps.
candidates.test_case: Measure the outer and inner edges of the apparent surfaces relative to the vehicle centreline and outer edge.
candidates.applies_because: This defines how the lateral position requirements of the functions are assessed.

candidates.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of each rear lamp function shall not be intentionally varied while the function is switched ON.
candidates.test_case: Monitor the intensity, colour and apparent surface of each function over time while it is ON.
candidates.applies_because: This applies to the steady-burning rear position, stop and reversing functions.

candidates.text: The photometric characteristics of a rear lamp function may vary in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp provides another function, provided that any variation complies with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
candidates.test_case: Measure the varied intensities and check them against the device regulation limits.
candidates.applies_because: Variable intensity and position/stop incorporation are open options of this lamp.

candidates.text: Red light emitted by the rear lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp and red retro-reflector) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
candidates.test_case: Check the visibility of the red apparent surfaces from the front of the vehicle.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp emits red light at the rear of the vehicle.

candidates.text: There shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of any red function of the rear lamp for an observer moving within Zone 1 (between 1 m and 2.2 m height, bounded by planes at 15° outwards) in a transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle.
candidates.test_case: Perform an observation or CAD sight-line check from Zone 1, 25 m in front of the vehicle.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp contains red rear functions.

candidates.text: In case of doubt, the prohibition of red light to the front is deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of red light emitted by the rear lamp towards the front, as verified at lamp type approval, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp, taking the vehicle body into account where applicable.
candidates.test_case: Photometric measurement of red light emitted forward by the lamp.
candidates.applies_because: This is an alternative compliance criterion for the red rear functions.

candidates.text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamps shall be such that they can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously with the front position lamps, the end-outline and side-marker lamps (if they exist) and the rear registration plate lamp.
candidates.test_case: Functional check of the lighting switch states and lamp activation.
candidates.applies_because: The product includes a rear position lamp.

candidates.text: The simultaneous switching requirement does not apply while the rear position lamps are switched ON as parking lamps, while daytime running lamps are ON, or while the front position lamp function is substituted under paragraph 5.12.1.
candidates.test_case: Functional check of the parking-lamp and DRL modes.
candidates.applies_because: This is an exemption to the rear position lamp switching rule.

candidates.text: In case the rear lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system, all its light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
candidates.test_case: Functional check of simultaneous activation of all interdependent lamps.
candidates.applies_because: The 'Y' interdependent lamp system is an open option.

candidates.text: The rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector shall not be concealed.
candidates.test_case: Inspect that the lamp is permanently exposed.
candidates.applies_because: Concealment is permitted only for headlamps and front fog lamps.

candidates.text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
candidates.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the reversing lamp.
candidates.applies_because: The product includes a reversing lamp.

candidates.text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
candidates.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the stop lamp.
candidates.applies_because: The product includes a stop lamp.

candidates.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
candidates.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the rear position lamp.
candidates.applies_because: The product includes a rear position lamp.

candidates.text: The colour of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
candidates.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the retro-reflected light.
candidates.applies_because: The product includes an integral non-triangular rear retro-reflector.

candidates.text: The number of rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors mounted on the vehicle shall equal the number indicated in the individual specifications of UN R48.
candidates.test_case: Count the installed functions on the vehicle.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp provides these functions on the vehicle.

candidates.text: In case the rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector is installed on a movable component (e.g. tailgate), the lamp shall meet all position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component.
candidates.test_case: Check position, visibility and photometry at each fixed tailgate position.
candidates.applies_because: The rear lamp may be mounted partly on a tailgate.

candidates.text: In case the rear position or retro-reflector function on a movable component is obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D", only one of the lamps needs to meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component.
candidates.test_case: Check the 'D' lamp on the fixed part at all tailgate positions.
candidates.applies_because: Assembly 'D' and mounting on a movable component are possible options.

candidates.text: Additional rear position lamps or retro-reflectors may be switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that they satisfy all position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps on the movable component.
candidates.test_case: Measure the additional lamps with the tailgate open.
candidates.applies_because: This applies when rear position or retro-reflector functions are on a tailgate.

candidates.text: In case the rear position function on a movable component is provided by an interdependent lamp system, either the complete system on the movable component shall meet paragraph 5.18.1, or, if partly on the fixed component, the interdependent lamp(s) specified at device approval shall meet all position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component.
candidates.test_case: Check the specified interdependent lamps at all tailgate positions.
candidates.applies_because: The 'Y' system and mounting on a movable component are options.

candidates.text: In case the rear lamp is installed on a movable component, it shall not cause undue discomfort to road users when the movable component is in a position other than the normal position of use.
candidates.test_case: Assess glare and discomfort with the tailgate open.
candidates.applies_because: This applies to tailgate-mounted lamp parts.

candidates.text: In case the rear lamp is installed on a movable component, it shall always return to the position specified by the manufacturer when the movable component is in the normal position of use.
candidates.test_case: Cycle the tailgate and re-measure lamp position and orientation.
candidates.applies_because: This applies to tailgate-mounted lamp parts.

candidates.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp and the rear retro-reflector shall not be hidden by more than 50 per cent by any movable component in any fixed position different from the normal position of use.
candidates.test_case: Measure the obscured share of the apparent surface at each fixed position of the movable components.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp contains a rear position lamp and a retro-reflector that tailgates may obscure.

candidates.text: If the 50 per cent limit is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the rear position lamp or retro-reflector shall be switched ON when the apparent surface is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
candidates.test_case: Verify activation and photometry of the additional lamps in the obscuring positions.
candidates.applies_because: This is an alternative where the rear lamp is obscured by a movable component.

candidates.text: The rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions shall be capable of being made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse; otherwise they are deemed not to be present.
candidates.test_case: Functional check that each function operates when installed with standard wiring and fuse.
candidates.applies_because: These lamp functions must be operative on the vehicle; the retro-reflector is excepted.

candidates.text: A temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function is allowed, provided that the replacement function is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the failed function and the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.
candidates.test_case: Simulate a rear position lamp failure and measure the colour, intensity and position of the replacement.
candidates.applies_because: This option applies to the rear position lamp of the product.

candidates.text: During a temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp, a tell-tale on the dashboard shall indicate the occurrence of the temporary replacement and the need for repair.
candidates.test_case: Simulate a failure and check the tell-tale activation.
candidates.applies_because: This applies if the fail-safe replacement option is used for the rear position lamp.

candidates.text: In case of variable luminous intensity control, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 that are combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated shall vary in intensity all together, in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
candidates.test_case: Measure the intensities of both functions across the variable intensity range.
candidates.applies_because: Variable intensity control is an open option for the stop and rear position lamps.

candidates.text: In case of variable luminous intensity control, the prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of the stop lamp and the rear position lamp shall be maintained over the entire intensity range, including during variation transitions.
candidates.test_case: Measure the stop-to-position intensity ratio during transitions.
candidates.applies_because: Variable intensity control is an open option.

candidates.text: In case of variable intensity control, the luminous intensity of the R2/S2 functions may increase or decrease within the limits of the pertinent UN Regulations in relation to ambient lighting, fog, snowfall, rain, spray, dust clouds or contamination of the light-emitting surface.
candidates.test_case: Check the intensity range against the R148 limits under the simulated conditions.
candidates.applies_because: This is a permission for the variable intensity option.

candidates.text: In case of variable intensity control, a decrease of the R2/S2 luminous intensity within the regulation limits is allowed while the vehicle speed is ≤ 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is ≤ 20 m; an already activated decrease may remain active up to a vehicle speed of 50 km/h.
candidates.test_case: Vehicle test of the intensity reduction at the speed and distance thresholds.
candidates.applies_because: This is a permission for the variable intensity option.

candidates.text: In case of variable intensity control, no sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.
candidates.test_case: Record the intensity over time during transitions.
candidates.applies_because: This applies to the variable intensity option.

candidates.text: For the stop lamp and rear position lamp tested at type approval with a special power supply, electronic light source control gear, secondary operating mode or applicant-requested voltage, the voltage supplied at their terminals shall not exceed the voltage at which they were approved.
candidates.test_case: Measure the terminal voltage in the vehicle's constant voltage operating condition.
candidates.applies_because: The stop and rear position lamps are devices listed in paragraph 5.27.

candidates.text: In other cases, for 12 V systems, the voltage at the terminals of the stop lamp and rear position lamp shall not exceed 13.5 V by more than 3 per cent.
candidates.test_case: Measure the lamp terminal voltage with the vehicle electrical system at constant voltage operation.
candidates.applies_because: An M1 vehicle typically has a 12 V system supplying the lamp.

candidates.text: In other cases, for 24 V systems, the voltage at the terminals of the stop lamp and rear position lamp shall not exceed 28 V by more than 3 per cent.
candidates.test_case: Measure the lamp terminal voltage under constant voltage operation.
candidates.applies_because: This applies if the vehicle uses a 24 V system.

candidates.text: The means of controlling the maximum voltage at the lamp terminals may be located within the body of the rear lamp.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the lamp circuit design for a voltage regulation means.
candidates.applies_because: This is a permission for the lamp's LED driver design.

candidates.text: The terminal voltage limits of paragraphs 5.27.1 and 5.27.2 do not apply if the rear lamp includes an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control as part of the device.
candidates.test_case: Check the device documentation for integrated control gear or variable intensity control.
candidates.applies_because: Integrated electronic control gear on the PCB is an open option.

candidates.text: There shall be no obstacle within the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of each rear lamp function observed from infinity, except obstacles already present when the lamp was type-approved.
candidates.test_case: CAD or physical sight-line check of the visibility angles on the installed lamp.
candidates.applies_because: All functions of the lamp have prescribed geometric visibility angles.

candidates.text: If any part of the apparent surface of a rear lamp function is hidden by other vehicle parts when installed, the unhidden part of the lamp shall still conform to the photometric values prescribed for approval of the device.
candidates.test_case: Photometric measurement of the lamp with the vehicle obscuration simulated.
candidates.applies_because: Body parts may partly obscure the installed lamp.

candidates.text: When the vertical geometric visibility angle below the horizontal may be reduced to 5° (lamp less than 750 mm above the ground, measured from the H plane), the photometric field of measurement of the installed lamp may be reduced to 5° below the horizontal.
candidates.test_case: Measure the H-plane height and photometry down to 5° below the horizontal.
candidates.applies_because: This applies if lamp functions are mounted below 750 mm.

candidates.text: In case the rear lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system, the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
candidates.test_case: Check visibility with all interdependent lamps ON.
candidates.applies_because: The 'Y' interdependent system is an open option.

candidates.text: The LED modules of the rear lamp need not be replaceable, provided that this is stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
candidates.test_case: Check the R148 communication sheet for the non-replaceable statement.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp uses non-replaceable LED modules.

candidates.text: The rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp shall be type approved according to UN R148, and the rear retro-reflector according to UN R150, when installed on the vehicle.
candidates.test_case: Verify the approval markings and certificates for R148 and R150.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp functions and the retro-reflector require device approval.

candidates.text: In case the rear lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to UN R148.
candidates.test_case: Verify that the R148 approval covers the lamp with its logo.
candidates.applies_because: A logo in the lamp is an open option.

candidates.text: On M1 vehicles, one reversing lamp device is mandatory and a second reversing lamp device is optional.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the vehicle and count the installed reversing lamps (1 or 2).
candidates.applies_because: The lamp provides the reversing lamp function for an M1 passenger car.

candidates.text: Reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
candidates.test_case: Check that the reversing lamp carries a valid R23 or R148 approval mark.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp's reversing function needs device approval for installation.

candidates.text: The reversing lamp shall be mounted not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
candidates.test_case: Measure the lowest and highest points of the reversing lamp apparent surface above the ground on the vehicle.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp's reversing function is installed on an M1 vehicle.

candidates.text: The reversing lamp shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation position.
candidates.applies_because: The rear combination lamp contains the reversing function.

candidates.text: For reversing lamps installed at the rear, the vertical angle of geometric visibility α shall be 15° upwards and 5° downwards.
candidates.test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the apparent surface is visible over α = +15°/-5°.
candidates.applies_because: The reversing lamp is installed at the rear of the vehicle.

candidates.text: Where there is only one reversing lamp, the horizontal angle of geometric visibility β shall be 45° to the right and to the left.
candidates.test_case: Verify visibility of the apparent surface over β = 45° left and right.
candidates.applies_because: An M1 vehicle may have a single reversing lamp in this lamp.

candidates.text: Where there are two reversing lamps, the horizontal angle of geometric visibility β shall be 45° outwards and 30° inwards.
candidates.test_case: Verify visibility of each apparent surface over 45° outwards and 30° inwards.
candidates.applies_because: An M1 vehicle may optionally have a second reversing lamp, e.g. one in each rear combination lamp.

candidates.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the reference axis direction on the vehicle.
candidates.applies_because: The reversing function's orientation is set by the lamp design and its mounting.

candidates.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the reversing lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and the device which controls starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in a position where the propulsion system can operate.
candidates.test_case: Functional check of the reversing lamp activation in all gear and ignition states.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp's reversing function is wired into the vehicle.

candidates.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the propulsion system cannot operate.
candidates.test_case: Disengage reverse, then switch off propulsion, and check that the lamp goes OFF in each case.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp's reversing function is wired into the vehicle.

candidates.text: A tell-tale for the reversing lamp is optional; however, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
candidates.test_case: Check the R148 failure-mode provisions and verify the failure tell-tale by simulating an LED failure.
candidates.applies_because: The reversing lamp uses non-replaceable LEDs, for which R148 may require failure signalling.

candidates.text: Stop lamps of category S1 or S2 are mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the vehicle for the presence of S1/S2 stop lamps.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp provides the S1/S2 stop lamp function.

candidates.text: Two S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be fitted.
candidates.test_case: Count the S1/S2 stop lamps on the vehicle.
candidates.applies_because: The stop lamp in the rear combination lamp is one of the pair.

candidates.text: Stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
candidates.test_case: Check for a valid R7 or R148 approval marking with S1/S2 category.
candidates.applies_because: The stop lamp function needs device approval.

candidates.text: For M1 vehicles, the point on the apparent surface of the S1 or S2 stop lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
candidates.test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the outer edge of the apparent surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge.
candidates.applies_because: The S1/S2 stop lamp is installed on an M1 vehicle.

candidates.text: S1 or S2 stop lamps shall be mounted not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and optional lamps are not installed).
candidates.test_case: Measure the lowest and highest points of the stop lamp apparent surface above the ground.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp contains an S1/S2 stop lamp.

candidates.text: S1 or S2 stop lamps shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the installation position.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp contains an S1/S2 stop lamp.

candidates.text: The horizontal angle of geometric visibility of S1 or S2 stop lamps shall be 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, except that for lamps mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane) the inward angle may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
candidates.test_case: Verify visibility of the apparent surface over the horizontal angles on the vehicle.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp's stop function is S1/S2.

candidates.text: The vertical angle of geometric visibility of S1 or S2 stop lamps shall be 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane) the downward angle may be reduced to 5°.
candidates.test_case: Verify visibility of the apparent surface over the vertical angles on the vehicle.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp's stop function is S1/S2.

candidates.text: The stop lamp shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the reference axis direction.
candidates.applies_because: The stop lamp is part of this rear lamp.

candidates.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
candidates.test_case: Apply the service brake and check that all stop lamps light simultaneously.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp's stop function is wired to the braking signal.

candidates.text: The stop lamps need not function if the device which starts and/or stops the propulsion system is in a position that makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate.
candidates.test_case: Check the stop lamp behaviour with the propulsion system switched off.
candidates.applies_because: This is a permitted relaxation for the stop lamp function.

candidates.text: A tell-tale for the stop lamps is optional; however, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
candidates.test_case: Simulate an LED failure and verify the failure tell-tale where R148 requires it.
candidates.applies_because: The stop lamp uses non-replaceable LEDs, for which R148 may require failure signalling.

candidates.text: Rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 are mandatory.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the vehicle for rear position lamps.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp provides the rear position lamp function.

candidates.text: Two rear position lamps shall be fitted, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
candidates.test_case: Count the lamps and check for an R7 or R148 approval marking.
candidates.applies_because: The rear position lamp in this lamp is one of the mandatory pair.

candidates.text: The point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
candidates.test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the outer edge of the apparent surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge.
candidates.applies_because: The rear position lamp is mandatory on the M1 vehicle.

candidates.text: Rear position lamps shall be mounted not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and optional lamps are not installed).
candidates.test_case: Measure the lowest and highest points of the apparent surface above the ground.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp contains the rear position function.

candidates.text: Rear position lamps shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the installation position.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp contains the rear position function.

candidates.text: The horizontal angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be 45° inwards and 80° outwards, except that where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane) the inward angle may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
candidates.test_case: Verify visibility of the apparent surface over 45° inwards and 80° outwards.
candidates.applies_because: This is the default visibility requirement for the rear position function.

candidates.text: The vertical angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane) the downward angle may be reduced to 5°.
candidates.test_case: Verify visibility of the apparent surface over ±15° vertically.
candidates.applies_because: This is the default visibility requirement for the rear position function.

candidates.text: For M1 vehicles, as an alternative at the manufacturer's discretion and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed, the horizontal angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp may be 45° outwards to 45° inwards, with the inward angle reducible to 20° under the H plane where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm.
candidates.test_case: If the alternative is chosen, confirm a rear side-marker lamp is fitted and verify visibility over ±45°.
candidates.applies_because: This is an optional alternative for M1 rear position lamps.

candidates.text: Under the alternative visibility option for M1 vehicles, the vertical angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be 15° above and below the horizontal, with the downward angle reducible to 5° where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm.
candidates.test_case: Verify vertical visibility over ±15°, or +15°/-5° below 750 mm.
candidates.applies_because: This is an optional alternative for M1 rear position lamps.

candidates.text: Under the alternative visibility option, to be considered visible the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of at least 12.5 cm² of its apparent surface, excluding the illuminating surface of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light.
candidates.test_case: Measure the unobstructed projected apparent surface area at the boundary angles, excluding the retro-reflector area.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp integrates a non-light-transmitting retro-reflector that must be excluded.

candidates.text: The rear position lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the reference axis direction.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp contains the rear position function.

candidates.text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamps shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11, i.e. the rear position lamps shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously with the front position lamps, end-outline and side-marker lamps (if any) and the rear registration plate lamp, except in the cases listed in paragraph 5.11.1.
candidates.test_case: Functional check of simultaneous switching with the position lamp switch.
candidates.applies_because: The rear position function is wired into the vehicle's position lamp circuit.

candidates.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale is mandatory for the rear position lamps and shall be combined with that of the front position lamps; this does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
candidates.test_case: Switch on the position lamps and verify the combined tell-tale operates.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp provides the rear position function.

candidates.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamp is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
candidates.test_case: Simulate an LED failure and verify the failure tell-tale where R148 requires it.
candidates.applies_because: The rear position lamp uses non-replaceable LEDs under R148.

candidates.text: The parking lamp function may be performed by simultaneously switching ON the front and rear position lamps on the same side of the vehicle, in which case lamps meeting the rear position lamp requirements are deemed to meet the parking lamp requirements.
candidates.test_case: If parking function is provided, verify same-side front and rear position lamps light together.
candidates.applies_because: The rear position lamp may be used as an optional parking lamp on an M1 vehicle up to 6 m long.

candidates.text: In case the rear position lamp is used as a parking lamp, the connection shall allow the parking lamps on the same side of the vehicle to be switched ON independently of any other lamps.
candidates.test_case: Activate the parking function on one side and check that no other lamps are switched on.
candidates.applies_because: This applies if the rear position lamp provides the parking function.

candidates.text: In case the rear position lamp is used as a parking lamp, it shall be able to operate even if the device which starts the propulsion system is in a position which makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate.
candidates.test_case: Switch off the propulsion system and activate the parking function.
candidates.applies_because: This applies if the rear position lamp provides the parking function.

candidates.text: In case the rear position lamp is used as a parking lamp, a device which automatically switches OFF these lamps as a function of time is prohibited.
candidates.test_case: Leave the parking lamps on for an extended period and verify they are not switched off by a timer.
candidates.applies_because: This applies if the rear position lamp provides the parking function.

candidates.text: Where a rear fog lamp is fitted, the distance between the rear fog lamp and each stop lamp shall be greater than 100 mm.
candidates.test_case: Measure the distance between the rear fog lamp and the stop lamp apparent surfaces on the vehicle.
candidates.applies_because: The stop lamp position in this lamp must keep this distance from any vehicle rear fog lamp.

candidates.text: Non-triangular rear retro-reflectors are mandatory on motor vehicles.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the vehicle for rear retro-reflectors.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp integrates the non-triangular rear retro-reflector of an M1 vehicle.

candidates.text: Two non-triangular rear retro-reflectors shall be fitted, type-approved as Class IA or IB retro-reflectors according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
candidates.test_case: Check for an R3 or R150 approval mark with class IA or IB.
candidates.applies_because: The integral retro-reflector is Class IA or IB.

candidates.text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4) are permitted provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
candidates.test_case: Assess that any additional reflective elements do not impair the mandatory lamps.
candidates.applies_because: This permission applies if additional reflective elements are integrated in the lamp.

candidates.text: The point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
candidates.test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the retro-reflector's outer edge to the vehicle's extreme outer edge.
candidates.applies_because: The retro-reflector is integrated in the rear lamp of an M1 vehicle.

candidates.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be mounted not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm above the ground; not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp; up to 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively.
candidates.test_case: Measure the lowest and highest points of the retro-reflector illuminating surface above the ground.
candidates.applies_because: The retro-reflector is grouped with the rear lamps in this assembly.

candidates.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the installation position.
candidates.applies_because: The retro-reflector is part of this rear lamp.

candidates.text: The horizontal angle of geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector shall be 30° inwards and outwards.
candidates.test_case: Verify visibility of the retro-reflector over ±30° horizontally on the vehicle.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp contains the non-triangular rear retro-reflector.

candidates.text: The vertical angle of geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector shall be 10° above and below the horizontal, except that where the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane) the downward angle may be reduced to 5°.
candidates.test_case: Verify vertical visibility of the retro-reflector over ±10°, or +10°/-5° below 750 mm.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp contains the non-triangular rear retro-reflector.

candidates.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be oriented rearwards.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the retro-reflector reference axis direction.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp contains the non-triangular rear retro-reflector.

candidates.text: The illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector may have parts in common with the apparent surface of any other lamp situated at the rear.
candidates.test_case: Review the lamp drawing for overlap between the retro-reflector and the lamp apparent surfaces.
candidates.applies_because: The retro-reflector is integrated with the rear position, stop and reversing lamps behind a common lens.

candidates.text: In case the rear position lamp is installed on an M1 vehicle less than 6 m in length using the reduced geometric visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2, side-marker lamps shall be used on the vehicle to supplement this reduced geometric visibility.
candidates.test_case: Check the vehicle installation: if the rear position lamp meets only 6.10.5.2 angles, verify rear side-marker lamps are fitted.
candidates.applies_because: The rear position lamp may use the M1 alternative visibility of 6.10.5.2, which is only allowed with supplementing side-marker lamps.

candidates.text: In case the stop lamps are used for the emergency stop signal, the emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop lamps fitted.
candidates.test_case: Trigger the emergency braking logic signal on the vehicle and verify that all stop lamps operate simultaneously.
candidates.applies_because: The emergency stop signal is mandatory on M1 vehicles and may be given by the stop lamp of this rear lamp.

candidates.text: In case the stop lamps are used for the emergency stop signal, all the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
candidates.test_case: Measure the flash frequency and phase of all stop lamps during an emergency stop signal with a photodetector and oscilloscope.
candidates.applies_because: The LED stop lamp of this rear lamp must be able to flash at the emergency stop signal frequency when used for this signal.

candidates.text: In case the stop lamps are used for the emergency stop signal, the emergency stop signal shall operate independently of other lamps.
candidates.test_case: Activate the emergency stop signal with other lamps ON and OFF and verify its operation is unaffected.
candidates.applies_because: The stop lamp is combined in one body with position and reversing lamps, so the signal must not depend on them.

candidates.text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON and OFF automatically.
candidates.test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the signal activates and deactivates without driver action.
candidates.applies_because: This applies when the stop lamp of this rear lamp provides the emergency stop signal.

candidates.text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
candidates.test_case: Perform emergency braking below and above 50 km/h and verify the signal is activated only above 50 km/h with the logic signal present.
candidates.applies_because: This applies when the stop lamp of this rear lamp provides the emergency stop signal.

candidates.text: The emergency stop signal shall be automatically switched OFF if the emergency braking logic signal is no longer provided or if the hazard warning signal is activated.
candidates.test_case: Remove the emergency braking logic signal or activate the hazard warning and verify the signal switches OFF.
candidates.applies_because: This applies when the stop lamp of this rear lamp provides the emergency stop signal.

candidates.text: In case a lamp function of the rear lamp is used for an answer-back signal, the geometric visibility shall be in accordance with the individual specifications for that lamp, except that the geometric visibility may be reduced compared with those specifications.
candidates.test_case: Check the geometric visibility of the lamp in answer-back mode against the individual specification of the function used.
candidates.applies_because: The rear position or reversing lamp of this product may optionally provide the answer-back signal.

candidates.text: In case a lamp function of the rear lamp is used for an answer-back signal, the answer-back signal shall only operate under the park condition of the vehicle.
candidates.test_case: Attempt to activate the answer-back signal outside park condition and verify it does not operate.
candidates.applies_because: The rear position or reversing lamp of this product may optionally provide the answer-back signal.

candidates.text: If the answer-back signal provided by the rear lamp flashes, the flash frequency shall not exceed 2.0 Hz.
candidates.test_case: Measure the flash frequency of the answer-back signal with a photodetector.
candidates.applies_because: The rear position or reversing lamp of this product may optionally provide a flashing answer-back signal.

candidates.text: For lamps of the rear lamp used for the answer-back signal, the individual specific requirements for electrical connections and the conditions of paragraphs 5.11 and 5.12 may not apply.
candidates.test_case: Review the wiring concept to confirm that the deviation from 5.11 is limited to answer-back operation.
candidates.applies_because: This permission relaxes the simultaneous-switching rule of 5.11 for the rear position lamp when it is used for an answer-back signal.

candidates.text: In case the rear position lamp or reversing lamp is used for the answer-back signal, the maximum luminous intensity per lamp in answer-back mode shall not exceed 700 cd on or above the HH line.
candidates.test_case: Measure the luminous intensity on a goniophotometer in answer-back mode on and above HH and verify it is at most 700 cd.
candidates.applies_because: The rear position and reversing lamps of this product are approved lamps that may provide the answer-back signal.

candidates.text: The stop lamp shall not be used to provide the answer-back signal.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the vehicle function and wiring to verify the stop lamp is not activated by the answer-back signal.
candidates.applies_because: The product contains a stop lamp, which is excluded from answer-back use.

candidates.text: The answer-back signal may only be activated automatically in conjunction with the locking and unlocking of the door(s) and/or the detection of the vehicle user in proximity to the vehicle.
candidates.test_case: Verify that activation occurs only on lock/unlock or user proximity detection.
candidates.applies_because: This applies when the rear position or reversing lamp of this product provides the answer-back signal.

candidates.text: The lamp used for the answer-back signal may flash and/or vary in luminous intensity and/or vary in apparent surface.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the answer-back signal pattern to confirm it uses only flashing, intensity or apparent-surface variation.
candidates.applies_because: This permission covers the LED rear position or reversing lamp when used for the answer-back signal.

candidates.text: The duration of the optical indication of the answer-back signal shall not exceed 3 seconds, measured from the beginning to the end of the signal, irrespective of flashes, variations of intensity or variations in apparent surface.
candidates.test_case: Record the answer-back light output over time and verify the total duration is at most 3 s.
candidates.applies_because: This applies when the rear position or reversing lamp of this product provides the answer-back signal.

candidates.text: Any vehicle approved pursuant to this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved; the rear combination lamp as installed in series production (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions and the rear retro-reflector) shall therefore continue to meet the requirements of paragraphs 5 and 6.
candidates.test_case: On randomly selected production vehicles, carry out the Annex 9 checks of lamp visibility, position, orientation and luminous intensity of each function and compare them with the approved type and paragraphs 5 and 6.
candidates.applies_because: Series-produced M1 vehicles fitted with this rear combination lamp must keep the installation compliance shown at approval.

candidates.text: In case the rear combination lamp is a grouped or reciprocally incorporated arrangement in which the non-textured outer lens is excluded and the apparent surface of one function (F1) is determined as '7b' according to paragraph 2.10.2, function F1 shall not be transparent to the light of function F2.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the lamp drawing and sample with F2 lit and verify that no F2 light is transmitted through the F1 optical area when determining the apparent surface.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp combines rear position, stop and reversing functions behind a common outer lens, so the apparent surface of one function may be bounded by another function.

candidates.text: The apparent surface of each red lamp of the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp and rear retro-reflector), as installed on the vehicle, shall not be directly visible to an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
candidates.test_case: With the lamp installed on the vehicle, check from a transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle, throughout Zone 1, that no part of any red apparent surface is directly visible.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp emits red light and is mounted at the rear, so it must not show red light towards the front of the vehicle.

candidates.text: Zone 1, within which the red apparent surfaces shall not be directly visible towards the front, is bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m above the ground. In width it is bounded by a vertical plane forming an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane. That plane passes through the point of contact of a vertical plane parallel to the median longitudinal plane that delimits the vehicle's overall width; where there are several points of contact, the foremost point applies.
candidates.test_case: Lay out Zone 1 at 25 m in front of the vehicle using the 1 m and 2.2 m height limits and the 15° outward width limits, then verify the lamp is not visible from anywhere within it.
candidates.applies_because: This zone defines the observation region in which the red rear lamp's front-visibility check is made.

candidates.text: In case of doubt, the requirement of no direct visibility of red light towards the front shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp. This intensity is as verified during type approval of the lamp, taking into account the influence of the vehicle body where applicable.
candidates.test_case: Measure, or take from the lamp type-approval report, the red luminous intensity emitted towards the front, including any influence of the vehicle body, and confirm it is ≤ 0.25 cd per lamp.
candidates.applies_because: This relaxation allows the red rear lamp to demonstrate front-visibility compliance by meeting a forward luminous intensity limit.

candidates.text: In production, the position of the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector in width, height and length shall be such that the measured distances fulfil the individual specifications applicable to each lamp. The position is checked according to paragraphs 2.10.2, 2.10.3, 2.10.4, 2.3.3 and 5.4.
candidates.test_case: On a production vehicle, unladen on a flat surface, measure the illuminating-surface edges of each function for height, distance from the extreme outer edge and spacing, and compare with paras 6.4, 6.7, 6.10 and 6.14.
candidates.applies_because: Each function of the rear combination lamp is checked for position on production M1 vehicles during conformity of production.

candidates.text: In production, the measured angles of geometric visibility of each lamp function shall fulfil the individual specifications applicable to that lamp. The angle limits may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3° mounting variation permitted in paragraph 5.3.
candidates.test_case: On a production vehicle, check the visibility of each function's apparent surface over the specified horizontal and vertical angles, applying the ±3° allowance.
candidates.applies_because: The apparent surfaces of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and of the retro-reflector are checked for geometric visibility during conformity of production.

candidates.text: In production, red light from the rear position lamp, stop lamp and red retro-reflector shall not be visible towards the front of the vehicle, as checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10.
candidates.test_case: With the lamps lit, an observer moving within Zone 1, 25 m in front of the vehicle, verifies that no red apparent surface is directly visible; in case of doubt, red light emitted forwards is checked to be ≤0.25 cd per lamp.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp emits red light at the rear of an M1 vehicle, so no red light may be visible from the front.

candidates.text: When switched on from the vehicle electrical system, the rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp and their associated tell-tales shall function in accordance with paragraphs 5.11 to 5.14 and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
candidates.test_case: Activate each function in turn (position lamps switch, brake pedal, reverse gear) and verify that the correct lamps and tell-tales light and that the switching conditions are met.
candidates.applies_because: The LED functions of the lamp are supplied by the vehicle electrical system, and their electrical connections are checked in conformity of production.

candidates.text: The presence, number, colour (red for the rear position lamp, stop lamp and retro-reflector; white for the reversing lamp), arrangement and, where applicable, category of the lamps, together with their markings, shall fulfil paragraphs 5.15 and 5.16 and the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
candidates.test_case: Visually inspect production lamps on the vehicle for light colour, number of functions per side, arrangement and the R148/R150 approval markings and category symbols.
candidates.applies_because: The colours, number, arrangement and approval markings of the lamp functions are verified by visual inspection in conformity of production.

rejected.text: The moulded plastics retro-reflector of Class IA or IB shall withstand being kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C, followed by cooling for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.
rejected.applies_because: The PMMA moulded prism retro-reflector (P-05) is a Class IA/IB moulded plastics reflector subject to the heat resistance test.
rejected.test_case: Condition the retro-reflector samples for 48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C in dry air, then cool for 1 h at 23 °C ± 2 °C before inspection.

rejected.text: After the heat resistance test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device, and in particular of its optical component, shall be visible.
rejected.applies_because: This is the pass criterion of the heat test that applies to the Class IA/IB retro-reflector of the rear lamp.
rejected.test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector and its optical unit after heat conditioning for cracks or appreciable distortion.
